About.title: Beauty, elevated to an art form
About.p1: Female-founded with love, Love You Nail Studio grew from a passion for artistry, perfection and client comfort.
About.p2: Our signature Russian Manicure and Smart Pedicure are meticulously crafted using the finest non-toxic materials — ensuring every visit is a seamless blend of beauty, hygiene and well-being.

Services.title: Services crafted to perfection
Services.intro: From flawless everyday manicures to intricate nail art, every service is delivered with precision and care.
Services.manicureBody: A precise, painless dry manicure with immaculate cuticle work and a high-shine finish that lasts for weeks.
Services.pedicureBody: A meticulous, hygienic pedicure that leaves feet soft, healthy and beautifully groomed — down to the smallest detail.

ProductsTeaser.body: The Love You professional line brings salon-quality gel polish, nail care and tools to your fingertips. Launching soon.

MembershipsTeaser.body: Join once a year for members-only savings on every service, plus complimentary touch-ups between visits. Three tiers, tied to your home studio.

Reviews.title: Loved by many
list: I've tried so many nail salons, but I've never experienced this level of attention to detail. Everything feels premium, from cleanliness to comfort. My manicure lasts weeks and still looks brand new!

I feel completely safe here — the tools are sterilized to medical standards, and it's immediately noticeable. The cuticle work is flawless, painless, and precise. I wouldn't trust my nails to anyone else now.
This place is more than just a salon. The atmosphere is wonderful: a beautiful interior and calming music help me relax. Every visit leaves me with only positive impressions.
I tried dozens of salons before finding Love You. Everything — from the service to the technique and the atmosphere — is on another level. Now I know my nails will always look flawless.
I was nervous about trying a Russian e-file manicure, but here I finally did — and I'm obsessed. It was completely painless, and the cuticle work was maximally neat. I can't imagine going back.
Every visit feels like a little escape from my busy schedule. The technicians are always gentle and professional, and I leave not only with perfect nails but also in a wonderful mood.

FinalCta.title: The perfect nails for a flawless look
FinalCta.body: Book your appointment at the Love You studio nearest you and experience the difference.
